Picks lists this host's saved picks: startup commands kept with "agent
roster pick --save NAME", the newest version of each, with the task it was
picked for, its entry, who saved it and when. Given a NAME, it lists every
version of that one, newest first.

"agent roster pick --saved NAME[@VERSION]" prints a saved command again.

--json prints {"host", "picks": [...]}.

Usage:
  agent roster picks [NAME] [flags]

Examples:
  agent roster picks
  agent roster picks quick-edit
  agent roster picks --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for picks
      --json   Print the saved picks as one JSON document

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
